pack_unpack_any_message: pack a protobuf message into an Any type and unpack it back to the original message
convert_timestamp_to_json: convert a Timestamp protobuf message to and from RFC 3339 JSON string format
parse_duration_string: parse a duration string like '1.010s' into a Duration protobuf message and convert back
merge_fieldmask_messages: merge fields from a source message to a destination message using a FieldMask to specify which fields
use_struct_as_dict: use a Struct protobuf message like a Python dictionary to store and retrieve typed values
